question: Which of the following matrices is a diagonal matrix but not a scalar matrix?
explanation:
A diagonal matrix has all off-diagonal elements zero.

A scalar matrix is a diagonal matrix with all diagonal elements equal.

$\begin{pmatrix}2 & 0 \\ 0 & 3\end{pmatrix}$ is diagonal but its diagonal entries are not equal, so it is not a scalar matrix.
